dimensions.mission: Read the already completed research run honestly without redoing research or manufacturing closure.
dimensions.flexibility_and_history: Keep the existing owner-final receipt, source identities, results, drafts, assessments, reservations and full event history. All 536 real record hashes unchanged.
dimensions.context_efficiency: Reuse exact task, one source module, existing native fixture and two G11 cases; no local full gate or new framework.
dimensions.research_truth: Producer and source epochs have different scopes only under an exact saved stage reference. Historical UNKNOWN stays UNKNOWN. Explicit execution requests, pending work and real contradictions retain their owners.
dimensions.owner_operability: Same ordinary forge-run entry and repeat read the saved receipt with zero writes. READBACK does not imply current scientific readiness.
dimensions.execution_to_cashflow: Reduce misleading BLOCKED/retry work while granting no strategy, market or execution authority.
dimensions.monitoring_and_recovery: Immutable original receipt remains the recovery truth. Default accepted runtime check follows guarded merge; no stop, rewrite, budget refund or second receipt.
dimensions.build_vs_buy: Narrow project-owned provenance semantics in existing ladder and validator; no dependency, provider, schema, cache, service or scheduler.
dimensions.security: No credentials, source-data publication or external/scientific calls. Malformed hashes, source conflicts and G11 missing-readback/tampered-binding controls retained.
dimensions.red_team: Tests can pass with producer/source capability equal and miss this defect. The vertical intentionally separates them, verifies current compatibility is not claimed, and retains explicit-model and true-source negative controls.

capability_radar.watch: Only a reproducible missing/contradictory frozen source reference; no automatic science or data repair.

recovery: Keep the same stored receipt and data. Ordinary code revert can restore the old readback refusal; forward-fix without rewriting history.
